title: PR Hygiene configuration (.github/pr-hygiene.yml)
description: Per-repository settings for the Obelyth/obelyth-pr-hygiene reusable workflow. Read from the default branch, so a pull request cannot change them for itself.

milestone.description: quarter: the milestone named 'Qn YYYY' for the quarter the pull request was opened in, created with the quarter's last day as its due date when missing. none: milestones are left alone. Any other string: a milestone title to assign verbatim; it must already exist.

reviewers.description: GitHub logins to request a review from on every pull request. The author is skipped: nobody can review their own pull request.

copilot_review.description: Also request a Copilot code review (a paid feature on the account).

project.description: The Projects v2 board to keep in step with the pull request. Only used when the PROJECTS_TOKEN secret is set.

owner.description: The organization or user that owns the board.

number.description: The board's number, from its URL. 0 disables the projects job.

opened.description: Set when the pull request is added to the board and has no status yet.

merged.description: Set when the pull request is merged.

closed.description: What happens when it is closed without merging: 'remove' takes it off the board; any other value is a status option to set, falling back to removal when the board has no such option.
